CustomField.description: Optional one-hop traversal field. When the card is placed on a grandparent record page (e.g. AAR), set this to the lookup field on that object that resolves the actual parent (e.g. UHN_Contact__c on UHN_AAR__c). The controller will query this field first, then use the resolved Id as the child lookup parent. Leave blank when the card is placed directly on the parent object.
CustomField.label: Intermediate Parent Field
